content: I'm giving a Lean mini-workshop at the Einstein Institute of Mathematics (Hebrew U) on June 12th. If anyone is interested in participating, please DM me.

For those attending: the day before, June 11 at 4 pm we'll do a little show 'n tell, and also try to get Lean installed locally on people's machines, so that on the following day, as few people as possible need to work from live.lean-lang.org... If we have some experts on hand to circulate and help with installation, that would be a big help. Thanks!
